night_blindness_note: The family tradition (and the Phase-3 prior) mentions 'night blindness' (nyctalopia — a documented Civil War affliction tied to malnutrition/scurvy). The ROSTER confirms only 'wounded in action' at Cedar Creek; the flesh-wound (thigh/hip) is corroborated in Charles's eyewitness letter. Night blindness as a SEPARATE condition is NOT in the external record and would, if anywhere, appear in a pension/medical file -> handoff. Flagged as unverified family detail, not contradicted.
